scope: Client readability, exported TypeScript contracts and a runnable localhost web-application storage example. No change to the database storage protocol.

javascript_http_suite.skip: All-API cold replacement remains covered by the separate cloud Harness qualification.

cases: Lost commit response and repeated application intent create one task/receipt
Concurrent independent task creation and atomic completion/index removal
Revision-pinned pagination refuses to mix snapshots
Settings replay and stale optimistic edit

limitations: TypeScript declarations describe the HTTP contract; they are not runtime validation of arbitrary server responses.
The example API binds localhost and requires application authentication/authorization before public hosting.
Application receipts are retained and consume quota; their lifecycle must preserve the permitted retry lifetime. External side effects are outside the database transaction.
The current cloud performance gate remains open.
